svg.title: A derivative through the fixed-step solver checked by finite differences
svg.desc: Panel a: producer concentration at the final time against the producer growth-rate parameter, with a short tangent segment from automatic differentiation at parameter value one. Panel b: relative difference between central finite differences and the autodiff derivative against the finite-difference step on log axes; it falls with slope two to about ten to the minus ten, then rises as round-off dominates.
